projects.title: Kindertales - Childcare Management Software
projects.summary: All-in-one childcare management software for preschools and daycare centers.
projects.description: Kindertales is a comprehensive childcare management platform designed for multi-location providers. Features include versatile online billing, powerful center management, streamlined parent communication, waitlist management, attendance tracking, milestones tracking, and integrated CRM. The platform helps childcare centers manage operations, communicate with families and staff, meet licensing requirements, and streamline daily tasks.

projects.title: Construkted - 3D Reality Capture Platform
projects.summary: Share, explore, and understand your 3D capture of reality.
projects.description: Construkted Reality is a platform for sharing, viewing, and exploring 3D captures of real-world locations. Users can upload 3D assets, browse captured locations, and collaborate on spatial data. The platform provides tools for 3D visualization, asset management, and exploration of architectural and real-world sites.

projects.title: MyAIWiz - AI Tax Document Automation
projects.summary: Convert tax documents to returns in 60 seconds using AI.
projects.description: MyAIWiz is an AI-powered tax document automation platform designed for CPA firms. The system processes tax documents by extracting every field using AI, exports structured workpapers, and provides exception flags for missing data. Features include AI tax document organizer, IRS notice copilot, and audit-ready documentation. Built for high seasonal volume with optional licensed CPA review.

projects.title: Calmerceuticals - Premium Marine Collagen Supplements
projects.summary: Australian-made hydrolysed marine collagen supplements for skin health.
projects.description: Calmerceuticals is an e-commerce platform selling premium marine collagen supplements. The product line includes clinically proven formulations targeting skin health, perimenopause relief, and men's performance. Features include a quiz system, before/after photo reviews, and wholesale B2B login.

projects.title: Okani Travels - African Flight Booking Platform
projects.summary: Travel booking platform for flights, activities, and hotels across Africa.
projects.description: Okani Travels is a comprehensive travel booking platform focusing on African destinations. Features include flight booking for domestic, regional, and international routes, activity booking, secure payment processing, and trip management. The platform offers exclusive flight deals, multi-step booking process, and WhatsApp customer support.

projects.title: Shugic - Modern Web Application
projects.description: Shugic is a modern web application built with React.js. The platform features a responsive design with custom typography and a single-page application architecture with optimized performance and modern UI/UX principles.
